source.microdata: National Center for Health Statistics. Mortality Multiple Cause-of-Death public use file, 2021 (US file). Hyattsville, MD: NCHS.
source.record_layout: NCHS. 2021 Documentation, Mortality Multiple Cause-of-Death Public Use Record.
source.control_totals: NCHS. Multiple Cause of Death Public Use File, Control Total Table 1: resident deaths by ICD-10 code, United States, 2021.
source.published_check: Murphy SL, Kochanek KD, Xu JQ, Arias E. Deaths: Final data for 2021. National Vital Statistics Reports; vol 73 no 8. Hyattsville, MD: National Center for Health Statistics. 2024. Tables 2, 7 and 9.

role: archived sensitivity; 2021 was a COVID-19 peak year, so the 2023 counts in data/causes/ are the baseline

definitions.deaths: Deaths of US residents occurring in the 50 states and DC in 2021, classified by underlying cause of death (ICD-10). Records with resident status 4 (foreign residents) are excluded, as in NCHS tabulations.
definitions.cvd_deaths: ICD-10 I00-I99 (all diseases of the circulatory system)
definitions.covid_deaths: ICD-10 U07.1 (COVID-19); extra column beyond DESIGN.md, kept for a sensitivity on shares of non-COVID deaths
definitions.external_deaths: ICD-10 V01-Y89 (external causes of morbidity and mortality: injuries, poisonings, suicides, homicides); extra column for the sensitivity that applies the cohort multiplier to other deaths only
definitions.shares: cause deaths / all-cause deaths in the same cell, 6 decimals
definitions.age_group_start/end: inclusive ages in completed years from NCHS age recode 12; age_group_end is blank for the open-ended 85+ group
definitions.age_not_stated: cause_shares.csv omits deaths with age not stated; cause_shares_all_groups.csv lists them

checks.record_layout: Multiple-Cause-Record-Layout-2021.pdf (pdftotext -layout) gives resident status at 20, sex at 69, age recode 12 at 79-80, data year at 102-105, underlying cause at 146-149
checks.control_total_table_1: 8,116 ICD-10 codes parsed (pdftotext -layout); every row satisfies total mentions = underlying + secondary; underlying-cause counts equal the microdata for every code; they sum to 3,464,231
checks.nvsr73_08_table2: all-cause deaths by age group x sex (13 cols x 3 rows) match
checks.nvsr73_08_table7: deaths by age group (both sexes) for all causes, C00-C97, I20-I25, I60-I69, I00-I78, U07.1 match (13 cols each)
checks.nvsr73_08_table9: deaths by sex (all ages) for all causes, C00-C97, I20-I25, I60-I69, I00-I78, U07.1 match

notes: Year 2021 matches the NVSR 72-12 (2021) life tables archived in data/life_tables/2021/. CDC WONDER was not queried: its API requires accepting CDC's data-use agreement on the user's behalf. The counts here come from the NCHS public-use microdata and are checked against NCHS's own published totals (see checks). The smallest cause cell in cause_shares.csv has 250 deaths.
